centering: mean-center each voxel over selected first-cue presentations within each run (24 samples per run)
voxel_qc: finite in all selected first-cue presentations, before centering
ratings: six premeal/postmeal outcome ratings jointly z-scored within participant, ddof=0
pairs: unique different-run pairs, including cross-phase comparisons; 8640 pairs per participant
group_test: one-sided one-sample t test of participant value coefficients against zero
button_note: All selected samples have button label none; button-presence RDM is zero and button-side RDM is constant over retained pairs. Both are omitted as uninformative.
correction_family: previous 105 tests plus six new first-cue reduced-model tests; first-cue full-model tests were already counted

equivalence_check.reason: Value and cue-type predictor vectors are orthogonal on the retained cross-run pairs; dropping cue type leaves value coefficients unchanged.
equivalence_check.interpretation: These rows are the same value-coefficient result and are not independent replications; the 111-test adjustment remains conservative.
